hulahoot_swess_enabled_package_help: Purchasing this package automatically grants the buyer SWESS access (subject to Admin's usual SWESS configuration for that user).

hulahoot_is_open_help: Sold as its own inventory, not tied to any industry

hulahoot_is_renewable_help: This package gets the 30-day renewal/grace flow
hulahoot_is_renewable_detail: Off by default. When on, a holder gets renewal reminder emails before expiry and a 30-day grace window after it. When off, access simply ends the moment the term expires - no reminders, no grace window.
hulahoot_locked_pending_admin_help: This package's slot was auto-locked after an unrenewed holder's grace period lapsed
hulahoot_locked_pending_admin_detail: Hidden from the public storefront until you uncheck this box, even if it has open slots. Uncheck and save to put it back on the market.
hulahoot_monthly_credits_help: Configured amount only - display purposes for now. Credits are not yet earned, spent, or enforced.
